description: Stripe alumni-founded agentic commerce platform building ATXP — a web-wide protocol enabling AI agents to autonomously handle the full commerce lifecycle (discovery → negotiation → payment) without human oversight.
agents: Agents that browse and discover products across the web
Agents that negotiate prices with merchants autonomously
Agents that execute payments on behalf of users (agent-to-agent transactions)
Agents that manage the full procurement and checkout lifecycle

pp_fit.feature: Authorization receipts for every agent-executed financial transaction — turning autonomous commerce into auditable, defensible, enterprise-grade payments
pp_fit.integration_complexity: low-medium — they're building a protocol (ATXP); PP can be a required compliance layer in the protocol spec
pp_fit.urgency: critical — ATXP explicitly removes human oversight from payments. Without authorization receipts, there's no dispute resolution layer, no enterprise adoption path, no regulatory compliance story. PP fills the exact hole their architecture creates.
pp_fit.strategic_angle: PP is to ATXP what TLS is to HTTP — the security and trust layer the protocol needs to go enterprise. Could be a protocol-level partnership, not just a customer relationship.
